description: Fully managed cloud database platform for modern applications with vector search, administration, and management capabilities.
auth_notes: Uses service account access tokens (OAuth 2.0 client credentials) or API keys (HTTP Digest / basic headers) for programmatic administration API access.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Atlas account self-service and generate API keys or service account credentials at no cost.
api_notes: Covers comprehensive administrative resources (clusters, projects, users, backups) via the Atlas Administration API and embedding/reranking APIs.
mcp_notes: MongoDB Atlas provides delegated app access settings including Model Context Protocol (MCP) client support.
rationale: MongoDB Atlas offers broad public REST APIs, robust self-service account creation with free tiers, and official support for MCP clients.

evidence.note: Atlas Programmatic Access overview detailing APIs, SDKs, and Terraform support.
Details authentication via service account access tokens (OAuth 2.0) and API keys.
Describes self-service creation of service accounts and API keys after creating a free Atlas account.
References delegated access settings for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients.
